question: On what supports and materials should the ritual items be arranged?
premises: Fragrance and similar items are included
inference: The items should be arranged on heaps of rice and on rests made with fragrance and darbha brushes.
uncertainties: Exact compound segmentation of gandha-ādi-darbha-kūrca-āyaneṣu is interpretive
plain_english: On heaps of rice, and on rests made with fragrance and darbha-grass brushes.
